# SOP-invoked runtime (repoint happens per-script after a verified identical run).
# build-graph-notes.py is repo-only (no vault copy; the vault holds its OUTPUT in Graph/)
# build-section-index.py is repo-only (no vault copy; the vault holds its OUTPUT in Automation/section-index.tsv)
# tools/retrieve.py is repo-only (reads the derived index; sessions call it via run.sh retrieve)
# workflows/*.workflow.js are repo-only (agent-graph orchestration, invoked by local Claude Code sessions via the Workflow tool; SOP pointers live in the vault files that own each job)
